sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: empirical_proportion_over_time
# Return per paper: year and empirical flag (data collection not "no collection" AND data analysis not "no analysis")
SELECT ?paper ?year ?is_empirical WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label }
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da rdfs:label ?da_label }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?dc_label) && LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection") && BOUND(?da_label) && LCASE(STR(?da_label)) != LCASE("no analysis"), 1, 0) AS ?is_empirical)
}
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: empirical_methods_over_time
# Return paper, year, and data collection method type label (excluding no method)
SELECT ?paper ?year ?method_type_label WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?method_type .
  ?method_type rdfs:label ?method_type_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?method_type_label)) != LCASE("no method"))
}
ORDER BY ?year ?method_type_label

# id: specific_methods_proportion_over_time
# Return paper, year, and method type label filtered to experiment, secondary research, survey, case study, action research
SELECT ?paper ?year ?method_type_label WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?method_type .
  ?method_type rdfs:label ?method_type_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?method_type_label)) IN (LCASE("experiment"), LCASE("secondary research"), LCASE("survey"), LCASE("case study"), LCASE("action research")))
}
ORDER BY ?year ?method_type_label

# id: statistical_methods_frequency

  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .

  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))

  ?da orkgp:P56043 ?is .
  ?is orkgp:P35133 ?st .
  ?st rdfs:label ?stat_label .
}
ORDER BY ?stat_label

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: data_provision_over_time
# Return paper, year, data type label, and whether a data URL is provided
SELECT ?paper ?year ?data_type_label ?has_url WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?dc orkgp:DATA ?data .
    OPTIONAL { ?data orkgp:P7055 ?dt . ?dt rdfs:label ?data_type_label . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?data_type_label)) != LCASE("Data Type")) }
    OPTIONAL { ?data orkgp:url ?url . }
  }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?url), 1, 0) AS ?has_url)
}
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: research_question_answer_over_time
# Return paper, year, flags indicating whether research question and research question answer are reported
SELECT ?paper ?year ?has_rq ?has_rqa WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P37330 ?rq . }
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P57004 ?rqa . }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?rq), 1, 0) AS ?has_rq)
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?rqa), 1, 0) AS ?has_rqa)
}
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: methods_for_secondary_research
# Return paper, method type label, and method name label for papers conducting secondary research (reviews)
SELECT ?paper ?method_type_label ?method_name_label WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?method_type .
  ?method_type rdfs:label ?method_type_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?method_type_label)) = LCASE("secondary research"))
  OPTIONAL { ?method orkgp:P145012 ?mn . ?mn rdfs:label ?method_name_label }
}
ORDER BY ?method_name_label

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: secondary_research_proportion_over_time
# Return paper, year, and flag indicating whether the paper uses secondary research method
SELECT ?paper ?year ?has_secondary_research WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
    ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label .
    FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection"))
    ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
    ?method orkgp:P94003 ?method_type .
    ?method_type rdfs:label ?mtl .
    FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mtl)) = LCASE("secondary research"))
  }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?mtl), 1, 0) AS ?has_secondary_research)
}
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: methods_per_publication
# Return paper and count of distinct data collection method types used (excluding no method)
SELECT ?paper (COUNT(DISTINCT ?method_type) AS ?method_count) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P135046 ?venue .
  ?venue rdfs:label ?venue_name .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?venue_name)) = LCASE("IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc .
  ?dc rdfs:label ?dc_label .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dc_label)) != LCASE("no collection"))
  ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?method .
  ?method orkgp:P94003 ?method_type .
  ?method_type rdfs:label ?mtl .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mtl)) != LCASE("no method"))
}
GROUP BY ?paper
ORDER BY DESC(?method_count)
